n21eb647381.headline: Ucom’s 4G+ network is the most extensive in Armenia
n21eb647381.summary: Armenian telecom operator Ucom launched new 4G+ stations in the Tavush region as part of its efforts to expand and modernize mobile coverage.
n21eb647381.why: Telecom infrastructure expansion supports digital economy growth and connectivity, impacting business and consumer markets.

n23ff5d2cfd.headline: Prague Will Pay an 11 Million Fine for the Troja Bridge. It Is Different from What Was Tendered and Also Three Times More Expensive | Aktuálně.cz
n23ff5d2cfd.summary: The cost of the Troja Bridge in Prague rose from under half a billion crowns to nearly three times that amount, resulting in an 11 million crown fine.
n23ff5d2cfd.why: Infrastructure cost overruns affect municipal budgets and investor confidence in public projects.
